column1: # LANES.tsv — one corpus per register, and which book each lane governs.
# WHAT THIS FILE IS
#   The register lane a ductus is measured against. A lane is a corpus, not a genre: the
#   books in it are all in the register a book in that lane should sound like. The ductus
#   names the lane in its Provenance, and `tools/prose/ductus-fit.py` measures the
#   resonant excerpts against that lane's documents.
# WHAT A LANE IS NOT
#   - Not a bucket for books that share a subject. Three horror novels in three registers
#     are three lanes, or one bad lane.
#   - Not the slop rule set. The scanner's rules are shared and genre-free, and its
#     caps are GLOBAL: one set in deslop-check.sh serves every lane. So a cap re-derived
#     on a second lane moves the first lane's thresholds too. That is an open design
#     question (per-lane caps need a scanner change, and a change to a cap is a freeze
#     event), not something this file resolves. What varies by lane today is the
#     comparison a ductus is measured against - which is what ductus-fit.py reads.
#   - Not a place to park text. Corpus files stay local and untracked
#     (calibration/.gitignore); only this path is in the repository.
# SIZE
#   A lane is 5-10 books, roughly 500k-1M words, all in the target register. The caps are
#   set at 1.5x the worst single document, so a thousand-book lane would loosen every cap
#   toward meaninglessness and average the register into "books". The tool prints the
#   measured size against this rule on every run; it does not enforce it, because a lane
#   under construction has to be measurable to be finished.
# WHERE A LANE LIVES
#   `path` is where the lane belongs. A checkout may hold the corpus under a book's own
#   calibration directory instead - the copies .gitignore explicitly allows - and
#   `ductus-fit.py` resolves a missing registered path to exactly one such copy, printing
#   which one it used. Two copies is a refusal, not a guess.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated; a space-separated row is a parse error, not a guess)
#   lane     slug the ductus names
#   role     governing | planned | control  (only one governing lane per book)
#   register one line: what a book in this lane sounds like
#   books    how many books are installed, 0 if none
#   words    measured words installed, 0 if none
#   path     repo-relative directory holding the documents
#   note     provenance and limits, one line
